places.name: Fogão Gaúcho Brazilian Steakhouse
places.short: Rodízio-style Brazilian steakhouse with tableside carving and a serious cocktail bar.
why: Gaúcho-style servers carve the meat right at your table, straight off the skewer. That's the whole show, and it's a good one.
Get to the bar early. In our footage the bartenders shake and pour every drink by hand, and the sparkling pours come with a little theater.
The dining room has a floor-to-ceiling wine wall and a spread of sides to build your plate around the meat.
Look for the bronze bull out front.

places.name: Omni San Francisco Hotel
places.short: Downtown hotel on the cable car line with a grand staircase lobby and in-room dining done right.
why: It sits at California and Montgomery, right on the cable car line, so the ride is part of arriving.
The lobby is the photo: a sweeping staircase, crystal chandeliers and dark wood.
In-room dining shows up under silver cloches. In our shoot that meant a burger and fries, a berry dessert and a drink by the window with the downtown towers outside.

places.name: Hilton Garden Inn Fairfield
places.short: Hotel off I-80 with an on-site restaurant and bar serving dinner and drinks.
why: The on-site restaurant and bar is open to guests for dinner and drinks.
In our footage: tacos, chips, a cold martini, a dragon-fruit drink, and cocktails out on the patio.
It's off I-80 near Solano Town Center, so it works as a stop between the Bay and Sacramento or wine country.
